metadata.title: Student Success | Digitonix Academy
metadata.description: Practical learning and career preparation at Digitonix Academy.

sections.heading: Real learners. Real experiences.
sections.description: Practical AI and digital marketing skills for your next career step.

items.title: Preeti Thawani
items.description: From student to SEO Executive — the practical training and live projects gave me the confidence and portfolio to land my first role.

items.title: Sneha Sanjay
items.description: The AI-integrated curriculum set me apart. I now manage social media for a growing e-commerce brand using skills I learned here.

items.title: Rohit Kumar
items.description: The internship was a game-changer. Working on real client accounts with real budgets prepared me for the actual job from day one.

items.title: Aakash Verma
items.description: The certification prep helped me earn my Google Ads certification. That credential opened doors and gave me an edge in interviews.

items.title: Nisha Agarwal
items.description: Learning AI tools inside every module was the highlight. I now use AI workflows daily to produce content at scale for multiple clients.

items.title: Karan Malhotra
items.description: The placement support was relentless. Mock interviews, resume prep, and referrals — they stayed with me until I landed the role.

items.name: Priyanka Choudhary
items.text: Digitonix Academy is hands down the best place for digital marketing. What I loved most was the practical approach — we did more live projects than theory. The mentors genuinely care about your growth.

items.name: Deeksha Vijayvargiya
items.text: I actually learned how to do work here, not only the theory. The instructors aren't just reading slides, they clearly work in the industry. Real-world examples made everything click.

items.name: Bhupendar Singh
items.text: My doubts were cleared patiently every time, the course structure is well planned and useful. Really appreciate the support from the entire team at the academy.

items.name: Trisha Sharma
items.text: I'm currently doing my digital marketing internship here and honestly it's been a great learning experience. Practical knowledge is prioritized and I got proper attention from mentors.

items.name: Rohit Kumar
items.text: Learning at the academy feels comfortable and stress-free. The trainers focus on practical learning instead of just theory. I got proper attention and guidance throughout.

items.name: Anjali Mehta
items.text: The mentors are supportive and motivating. They give personal attention whenever needed. Learning here feels comfortable and effective. I would recommend it to everyone.

sections.heading: Big goals? Start with a conversation.
sections.description: Ask about curriculum, fees and upcoming batches. Our team will help you find your fit.
